notToBeConfusedWith.name: Coconut cream
notToBeConfusedWith.note: A thicker, less diluted press of the same flesh, used where a recipe wants richness rather than a pourable liquid.

forms.label: Raw
forms.sourceNote: Nuts, coconut milk, raw (liquid expressed from grated meat and water). Public domain. The record's own tablespoon portion gives 1.0144 g/ml, adopted because coconut milk is poured, but marked estimated since a tablespoon can measure either a liquid or a packed solid and this one is not confirmed against a liquid measure.
